verdict.rationale: Event-driven rules are a fair axis for a database. The closest evidence is incremental materialized views, which run SQL automatically at insert time and act as insert-triggered transformation rules. They only cover insert events and in-database computation, not general rule definitions that trigger external actions. Missing for 10: general event/rule engine or triggers beyond inserts, external actions (webhooks, alerts, notifications), AI-native rule authoring, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
